mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, table_number, total_amount, status, remark, create_time, pay_time, prepare_time, finish_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{tableNumber}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{payTime}, #{prepareTime}, #{finishTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE table_number = #{tableNumber} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} ORDER BY create_time DESC
